authorized_effects: Adding withdrawn to PLAN_STATUSES, for a plan removed from admission consideration without being judged wrong and without a successor existing.
Setting PLAN-20260723-0002 status from proposed to withdrawn, moving a withdrawal recorded on 2026-07-27 from next_action prose into the status field.
Recording that withdrawn is deliberately absent from both open-status sets, so a withdrawn plan is not counted as open work.
blocked_effects: No change to any withdrawal decision. PLAN-20260723-0002 was withdrawn under DECISION-20260727-0002 on 2026-07-27; only its representation changes, and its next_action retains the original withdrawal text.
No weakening of the status vocabulary. An invented value is still refused, which a test asserts.
No new open-work state. withdrawn is not added to open_statuses at either site; adding it would reintroduce the misreading this decision corrects.
No retrospective reclassification of any other plan. Twenty-three plans exist and only PLAN-20260723-0002 was withdrawn without a successor.
rationale: DECISION-20260727-0002 withdrew PLAN-20260723-0002 together with ABS-0004 v8, on which its semantics depended, and found no truthful status for it. Rejected would assert the plan was judged wrong, which no finding established. Superseded would assert a successor exists, which none does. The plan therefore retained status proposed and its withdrawal was carried in next_action.

That decision recorded the cost in its own text: a next_action is weaker than a status field and will not be seen by anything reading status alone. It deferred the vocabulary change as a separate governance act rather than folding it into the withdrawal, which was correct.

The cost occurred. On 2026-08-17 the packaging executor surveyed open work by reading plan status, found PLAN-20260723-0002 reading proposed, and reported it as an open plan. The record predicting the failure was three weeks old and the failure was found by re-reading that record rather than by any check.

The change is narrow by construction. withdrawn is added to PLAN_STATUSES only. Both sites that define plan openness, the registry spec and the index builder, are left as proposed and admitted, so a withdrawn plan is not open work. A test asserts that PLAN-20260723-0002 is absent from open_plans, and mutation testing confirms that adding withdrawn to either open set fails two tests.

Falsified before reliance, per DECISION-20260812-0002: the value validates, an invented value is still refused with the vocabulary listed, and open_plans is empty after the change where it previously contained the withdrawn plan.
required_next_governance: Nothing in the repository detects a status field carrying less information than a record's own prose. This defect was recorded by the decision that created it and was found three weeks later by re-reading that decision, not by a check. Other records may carry the same shape.

The other status vocabularies were not examined. Capability, gap, verification and warrant records have their own value sets, and whether any of them lacks a value its records need was not tested here.
selection_effect: PLAN_STATUSES admits withdrawn. PLAN-20260723-0002 reads withdrawn and no longer appears in open_plans, which is now empty. No plan is open.
summary: The plan status vocabulary gains withdrawn, for a plan removed from admission consideration without being judged wrong and without a successor. PLAN-20260723-0002 was withdrawn on 2026-07-27 and has read proposed since, because no truthful value existed; the withdrawing decision recorded that carrying it in next_action would not be seen by anything reading status alone, and on 2026-08-17 that is exactly what happened. withdrawn is deliberately not an open status.
title: Admit withdrawn as a plan status and correct PLAN-20260723-0002
